turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.
I’m sorry your print hasn’t arrived. Please share your order number (SC-####) and the email address used for the order so I can check the delivery.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.
I’m sorry this has escalated. A colleague will take over and help with your delivery concern.

input.summary: Customer says their print has not arrived and they need help with delivery. They say they are filing a complaint with ANPC today, contacting their bank for a chargeback, and leaving a public review. Order number and order email have not been provided.
